title: Genetic Basis of SARS-CoV-2 Infection-Associated Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children (MIS-C)
official: Genetic Basis of SARS-CoV-2 Infection-Associated Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children (MIS-C)
summary: The project aims to investigate the molecular basis of pediatric inflammatory conditions associated with COVID-19 identified by the IDEA network, with the objectives of characterizing their genetic background, pathophysiology, and clinical spectrum, improving therapeutic strategies, defining follow-up programs, and identifying individuals at risk.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients presenting with specific clinical features characteristic of MIS-C and Kawasaki disease.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients presenting with other diseases.
